scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi Scholarship For Academic Excellence
other_conditions: Applicant must be a bonafide resident of Rajasthan
Applicant must be less than 35 years of age on 1 July 2023
Must have an admission or offer letter from a university ranked in the top 150 QS World Universities as of 1 April 2023
All disciplines are eligible for UG, PG, PhD and Post‑Doc courses
Maximum 7.5% seats (37 seats) are reserved for Engineering, Architecture, Medical and Dentistry courses at UG level
Priority is given to female students with 30% of seats earmarked
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹50 lakh tuition coverage plus living expense assistance (₹12 lakh for families earning <8 lakh, ₹6 lakh for families earning 8–25 lakh) and a one‑time advance of ₹3 lakh.
documents_required: Fee Details letters/Documents issued by Foreign University
